title: Empirical Scaling Benchmark: Multi-Krum + 10% Replay vs ZK-OPoI v5 at N = 32, 128, 512, 2048
hypothesis: At N in {32, 128}, Multi-Krum (O(N^2 d)) + 10% Spot-Check Replay achieves <30ms aggregation overhead and 100% Byzantine poisoning rejection up to f < N/2 - 1, outperforming full ZK-OPoI v5 on wall-clock overhead while maintaining equivalent model convergence. At N in {512, 2048}, full pairwise Multi-Krum distance matrices become quadratic-bound, making hierarchical Sub-Swarm Multi-Krum (k=16) + ZK-OPoI v5 Spot-Check Proof Verification the Pareto-optimal security regime.
